items.summary: The ggml/llama.cpp project updated its CUDA implementation by merging the RMS_NORM and SCALE operations into a single kernel, reducing unnecessary kernel launches and potentially improving performance. This change is significant as it optimizes the GDN layer computation, which can lead to more efficient processing in large language models like Qwen3.8-27B.
items.summary_detailed: The ggml/llama.cpp project has updated its codebase to fuse RMS_NORM and SCALE into one kernel, addressing the issue of adding 96 extra kernel launches per ubatch due to separate SCALE nodes for GDN layers in Qwen3.8-27B. This change is part of pull request #29393 and aims to optimize performance by reducing unnecessary kernel launches. The broader impact includes improved efficiency in handling GDN layers, potentially leading to faster processing times without significant loss in model accuracy.
items.summary_bullets:

• #28068 optimizes GDN q/k l2norm using ggml_scale(ggml_rms_norm(x, eps/n), 1/sqrt(n))
